review_regressions.scope: Content/privacy and source-timeline validation through packaging, reader and upload validation; same correctly checksummed ZIPs rejected after fix.

limits: Local read-only follow-up refers to a primary synthetic report, not mac24 H&M.
No Docker commands, images, dependencies or data were changed. No H&M replay, training, test or T6.
Current host clock metadata cannot prove the interpreter used in the past.
Temporal controls are tested utilities only; events-check and legacy memory validators remain unchanged.
Complete log collection does not prove absence of sleep or establish causality.

fixes.finding: Aggregate-only report accepted free text in attachments or manifest fields.
Recomputed timing accepted missing/reordered source snapshots and backward UTC.

rulings.decision: Collect read-only historical evidence before integrating a new H&M acceptance protocol.
rulings.reason: The temporal gap has no confirmed cause.
rulings.cost: One extra GitHub exchange before acceptance.

rulings.decision: Future temporal utilities retain the fixed 2-second continuity tolerance and 7200-second budget.
rulings.reason: Continuity guard rather than fitting the historical gap.
rulings.cost: A future clock adjustment may cause a reportable failure.

rulings.decision: mac24 historical availability and causal interpretation remain pending actual collection.
rulings.reason: Local execution cannot establish remote historical state.
rulings.cost: The historical cause may remain unknown.

rulings.decision: Unknown power categories are counted but do not prevent collection-complete status.
rulings.reason: Normal power logs include unrelated categories; completion is not exhaustive interpretation or absence proof.
rulings.cost: An unknown format may yield passed collection with no interpretable events; inspect unknown counts.

rulings.decision: Keep Timeline/AwakeGuard integration and the new memory criterion deferred.
rulings.reason: The read-only follow-up precedes the separately versioned prospective protocol.
rulings.cost: T5 stays open and needs implementation plus a subsequent measured run.

rulings.decision: Treat the independent 16-test review separately from our full suite and real Release roundtrip.
rulings.reason: The reviewer did not independently reproduce publication or the other host tests.
rulings.cost: Transport and full-suite evidence remain author-verified, not independently re-run.
